subject: Next steps: procurement contacts, PO timing & pilot billing for Orchid Health
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: procurement contacts, PO timing & pilot billing for Orchid Health

Hi Maya — great talking earlier. Quick recap from today’s discovery and a proposed path to get the pilot through procurement: 

Summary (2 min):
- Pilot scope: 3-week integration + 2-week acceptance (up to 100k tokens/week)
- Acceptance criteria: latency < 400ms p50 on our test harness; sample prompts pass the accuracy checks we ran today
- Pricing model for pilot: monthly invoiced pilot fee (itemized by usage + pilot support) — exact line items below

Questions / asks for procurement:
1) Who is the economic sponsor who will sign the PO? (name + email)
2) Procurement contact for vendor intake (name + email) and their preferred PO cadence (monthly vs. quarterly)
3) Invoice remit address & AP contact (email) for net-30 processing
4) Any mandatory compliance docs (DPA, SOC2 evidence, security questionnaire) and the internal intake form you prefer us to fill

Attachments: Redwood vendor questionnaire (redwood_vendor_questionnaire_20280601.pdf) — I attached our standard security + vendor intake packet so your team can see what we typically provide.

Proposed next steps:
- You share the procurement / AP contacts (if you can paste email(s) that’s ideal)
- I’ll loop in our finance/legal leads (Marissa + Jonas) to provide W-9, draft DPA, and line-item invoice template
- Suggest a 20-min procurement sync if helpful — available Tue/Wed next week (9–11am PT)

Thanks — will stand by for the contacts and timeline.

—
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Maya Patel <maya@orchidhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement contacts, PO timing & pilot billing for Orchid Health

Thanks, Soojin — useful summary. Quick answers below: 

1) Economic sponsor: Maya Patel (me) — I will approve the pilot commercially but procurement will issue the PO.
2) Procurement intake: Alex Rivera (alex.rivera@orchidhealth.com) — he handles vendor intake and PO routing.
3) AP contact: ap@orchidhealth.com (billing inbox)
4) Compliance asks: we require a DPA and evidence of SOC 2 Type II. I’ll attach our vendor intake form for your team to complete.

Timeline: Procurement aims to finish vendor onboarding by 2028-06-20 if we can provide docs this week.

I’ve attached Orchid_vendor_intake_form.pdf for the intake fields. Loop Alex on the next note — I’ll leave him on copy.

Best,
Maya
Director of Product, Orchid Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 09:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement contacts, PO timing & pilot billing for Orchid Health

Alex — great to meet you over email. Per Maya’s note, we can move quickly. I’ve attached the items you asked for and can get anything else your team needs: 

Attachments included:
- W-9_Redwood_Inc.pdf (fillable tax form)
- Redwood_DPA_draft_20280601.pdf (draft DPA; we’re happy to iterate)
- redwood_vendor_questionnaire_20280601.pdf (security/vendor intake answers)

A couple quick clarifications for the PO:
- Pilot billing model: we typically issue a monthly invoice for pilot usage & a small services line item. If Orchid prefers a single PO that covers monthly invoices across the pilot, we can format the invoice lines accordingly.
- For PO creation: do you need the SOW attached to the PO, or will a short description and line items suffice?

Marissa (cc’d) is our finance lead — she’ll confirm the invoice template and payment terms. Jonas (legal) can answer any DPA/contract questions.

Would you be available for a 20-min procurement call tomorrow (Tue 6/5) at 10am PT to run through the intake form and confirm the PO format? If not, we can do Wed morning.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

—
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@orchidhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement contacts, PO timing & pilot billing for Orchid Health

Thanks, Soojin. Quick replies from procurement: 

• Preferred billing: monthly invoices, net 30.
• Remit to: Orchid Health, Attn: Accounts Payable — use ap@orchidhealth.com for electronic invoice submissions.
• PO requirements: we need a short SOW attached (1–2 paragraphs) + line-item pricing (unit, qty, unit price, description).
• Insurance & tax: confirm vendor legal name and remit address on the W-9 so we can validate.

I’ve completed the intake form you sent (attached on our side) and set internal expectation to issue a PO by 2028-06-20 assuming the documentation is complete.

If you can share the firm remit address and confirm the SOW language, we’re good. I’m available for a 20-min call 6/5 at 10am PT.

—
Alex Rivera
Senior Procurement Manager, Orchid Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement contacts, PO timing & pilot billing for Orchid Health

Alex — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Confirming next steps from our side: 

1) I attached a concise SOW paragraph below (please copy/paste into the PO):
   "Redwood Inference will provide a three-week integration and a two-week pilot period providing model inference services for Orchid Health up to 100k tokens/week. Redwood will provide support hours for integration and a test harness to validate latency and functional acceptance criteria. Pilot invoices will be issued monthly. Acceptance will be based on the jointly-agreed test harness results."

2) Marissa — can you confirm we should send invoices to ap@orchidhealth.com and the remit address below?

Redwood legal name and remit address (from W-9):
Redwood Inference, Inc.
123 Market St, Suite 400
San Francisco, CA 94105

3) Jonas — I attached the draft DPA; can you flag any changes you’d like me to surface to the Orchid legal team?

4) I’ll join you on the 6/5 10am PT call. Maya — appreciate your help coordinating.

Attachments: W-9_Redwood_Inc.pdf, Redwood_DPA_draft_20280601.pdf (also uploaded to linked Drive)

Thanks all — I’ll follow up after the call with a HubSpot update and a checklist for procurement to close the PO.

—
Soojin
